_comment: What the registry knows about a card or printing that the official API does not say. One note per fact, each with where it came from and the day it was written down. A fact that fits a field is a correction and belongs in data/overrides.json. Sources say where, not who: releases are immutable, so name a person only if they asked to be credited. See registry/notes.py.

P001640.text: Prize support in the Arthurian Legends store kit, sent to stores for Organised Play when the set released. Each kit held three of this Sorcerer. Stores could reportedly request a second kit, which shipped with a Cornerstone kit. The release date on record, 2024-10-04, is Arthurian Legends' own.
